deploy/kubernetes/builds/api-env-patch.y.name: App build settings patch
deploy/kubernetes/builds/api-env-patch.y.description: Adds the app-build settings to the main server so it can start build tasks in the cluster.

deploy/kubernetes/builds/build-config.ya.name: App build task settings
deploy/kubernetes/builds/build-config.ya.description: Sets the identity, waiting limit and machine size used when the platform builds an app as an isolated task.

deploy/kubernetes/builds/kustomization.y.name: Builds overlay
deploy/kubernetes/builds/kustomization.y.description: Combines the base cluster setup with the extra permissions and settings needed for isolated app builds.

deploy/kubernetes/builds/rbac.yaml.name: App build permissions
deploy/kubernetes/builds/rbac.yaml.description: Lets the main server create and watch the short-lived tasks that build apps, and nothing else.

deploy/kubernetes/builds/scheduler-contr.name: Scheduler build patch
deploy/kubernetes/builds/scheduler-contr.description: Gives the timetable service the same app-build settings as the main server.

deploy/kubernetes/builds/serviceaccounts.name: App build identities
deploy/kubernetes/builds/serviceaccounts.description: Defines two cluster identities: one allowed to start build tasks, and one that runs them with no access at all.

k8s/api/deployment.yaml.name: Main server pods
k8s/api/deployment.yaml.description: Runs two copies of the main server so work continues if one restarts, with health checks and resource limits.

k8s/api/rbac.yaml.name: Server cluster permissions
k8s/api/rbac.yaml.description: Allows the main server to start, watch and clean up the short-lived background task pods.

k8s/api/service.yaml.name: Main server address
k8s/api/service.yaml.description: Gives the main server a stable internal address that the web app and other services call.

k8s/client/deployment.yaml.name: Web app pods
k8s/client/deployment.yaml.description: Runs two copies of the web app so the screens stay available during upgrades.

k8s/client/service.yaml.name: Web app address
k8s/client/service.yaml.description: Gives the web app a stable internal address where visitors' requests arrive.

k8s/configmap.yaml.name: Platform settings
k8s/configmap.yaml.description: Holds non-secret settings such as sign-in lifetimes, the public web address and the file storage location.

k8s/kustomization.yml.name: Cluster bundle
k8s/kustomization.yml.description: Lists the pieces that make up a full installation so an operator can apply them together.

k8s/local/api-rbac.yaml.name: Local server permissions
k8s/local/api-rbac.yaml.description: Lets the local test cluster's main server start and manage background task pods.

k8s/local/bifrost.yaml.name: Local platform stack
k8s/local/bifrost.yaml.description: Runs two main server copies in the local cluster, wired to local settings and sample secrets.

k8s/local/build-jobs.yaml.name: Local build identities
k8s/local/build-jobs.yaml.description: Defines the no-access identity and settings used when building apps inside the local cluster.

k8s/local/config.yaml.name: Local settings
k8s/local/config.yaml.description: Holds the local cluster's addresses, passwords and storage names for a throwaway environment.

k8s/local/init.yaml.name: Local setup task
k8s/local/init.yaml.description: Prepares the database once in the local cluster before the main server starts.

k8s/local/kind-config.yaml.name: Local cluster shape
k8s/local/kind-config.yaml.description: Describes the single-machine test cluster used for local experiments.

k8s/local/kustomization.yaml.name: Local bundle
k8s/local/kustomization.yaml.description: Lists the pieces of the local test setup so they can be applied in one go.

k8s/local/namespace.yaml.name: Local namespace
k8s/local/namespace.yaml.description: Reserves the separate area inside the cluster where local test pods live.

k8s/local/pgbouncer.yaml.name: Local database pooler
k8s/local/pgbouncer.yaml.description: Adds a connection-sharing service in front of the local database so many tasks can share it.

k8s/local/postgres.yaml.name: Local database
k8s/local/postgres.yaml.description: Runs the database that holds all platform records inside the local cluster.

k8s/local/redis.yaml.name: Local cache
k8s/local/redis.yaml.description: Runs the fast in-memory store used for sessions and short-lived work inside the local cluster.

k8s/local/seaweedfs.yaml.name: Local file storage
k8s/local/seaweedfs.yaml.description: Runs S3-compatible file storage for uploads and workspace files inside the local cluster.

k8s/namespace.yaml.name: Platform namespace
k8s/namespace.yaml.description: Reserves a separate area in the cluster where all of the platform's pods live.

k8s/scheduler/deployment.yaml.name: Retired timetable pods
k8s/scheduler/deployment.yaml.description: Keeps the old always-on timetable pods at zero now that the main server starts work only when needed.

k8s/secret.yaml.name: Secret settings template
k8s/secret.yaml.description: Shows which passwords and connection details an operator must supply, holding no real values itself.

k8s/worker/deployment.yaml.name: Retired worker pods
k8s/worker/deployment.yaml.description: Keeps the old always-on background task pods at zero now that the main server starts them on demand.
